note: y ~ x1 + x2; terms x1, x2. rows are [x1, x2, y] (+ g when cluster, + f when weighted). estimates .. ci_upper, df, at: the analytic closed forms (header) at the fit's fixed point, conf_level 0.95; df present where the statistic is a Student t (lm; gamma under the classical vcov). vcov: the covariance the effects read (vcov | sandwich vcovHC HC3 | vcovCL HC1 over g). me_estimates / me_std_errors: marginaleffects avg_slopes / slopes(newdata = 'mean'), numerical derivatives. _freq: glm(weights = f), equal to its rep() expansion (checked). _derived: x1 = log1p(z), x2 = (g == 'b'), pre-computed; raw carries [z, g index] per row. binary / contrasts (every block): binary = 'contrast' reports each listed 0/1 term as mu(1) - mu(0) (absent: slopes).
ordinal_note: REG_ORDINAL (polr, y ~ x1 + x2): per-level effects, outcome-major (for each outcome, for each term); rows are [x1, x2, y, w, g]. estimates .. ci_upper, at: the closed forms (the ordinal block's header) at the polished MLE, Wald z, conf_level 0.95; vcov: the covariance the effects read (analytic inverse information | hc1 | CR1 over g), over c(beta, zeta). scale link: the effect on each cumulative link g(P(Y <= k)), k < K (outcomes lists them); no marginaleffects counterpart. me_estimates / me_std_errors: marginaleffects avg_slopes / slopes at the weighted means on polr set to the MLE. _freq: polr(weights = w), equal to its rep() expansion (checked).
multinomial_note: REG_MULTINOMIAL (multinom, y ~ x1 + x2): per-category effects, outcome-major; rows are [x1, x2, y, w, g], y the 0-based index into levels (the dictionary order). estimates .. ci_upper, at: the closed forms (the multinomial block's header) at the polished MLE, Wald z, conf_level 0.95; coefficients / vcov: the polished MLE (category-major over the non-reference levels in multinom's order: reference first, then levels) and the covariance the effects read. scale response: one effect per level (dictionary order); scale link: per non-reference level, the coefficient; no marginaleffects counterpart. me_estimates / me_std_errors: marginaleffects avg_slopes / slopes(type = 'probs') at the weighted means on multinom set to the MLE. _freq: multinom(weights = w), equal to its rep() expansion (checked); _prob: w* = w n_eff / sum(w).
